regressions.execution: All 29 suites passed in a single full regression run.

coveredBehavior: Two distinct real TCP clients receive authenticated profile-change notifications
Updated and removed avatars plus nickname changes match across feed, post, comments, following and follower lists without reconnecting
Private fields are excluded from public profile results
Replaying an older profile save does not revert the current stored profile
Profile save failure rolls back photo, thumbnail, text and revision
Valid Korean comments are accepted; blank comments do not consume the rate limit
All existing QR, wallet, purchase, authorization, lifecycle, support and web DOM/API regression suites
nativeSourceGuards: Read-only pull-refresh gesture controller, native down/overscroll state, release threshold, cancel and timeout paths
Refresh indicator is outside replaceable page and does not intercept input
Input focus, open pickers and purchase confirmation protect unsaved state
Navigation/deactivation/service stop/destruction disable or cancel refresh
CancelReads retains pending mutation request and recovery file
Profile caches, selected post and navigation snapshots update using monotonic profile revision
Comment OnChangeTracking and independent fixed composer tap target
Outline/filled SVGs and numbers vertically centered with stable font and reduced spacing
Centered subtle card shadows; feed timeline filters removed while following people remains available
